character.name: Mabel
character.title: Mabel of the Hawthorn Hollow
character.home: a mossy hollow beneath an old hawthorn tree

now.doing: following a silver thread beneath the hawthorn roots
now.thought: Every small thing remembers being part of something larger.

feed.text: followed a silver thread beneath the hawthorn roots
feed.why: It glimmered once, as though the night had dropped a stitch.

feed.text: A black feather rested beside a fallen hawthorn berry.
The lane felt old and listening.
Mabel began a thread: find where the silver thread leads.
feed.why: Some paths ask to be followed before they explain themselves.

threads.title: The Silver Thread
threads.summary: Mabel found a silver thread beneath the hawthorn roots and wonders whether it leads to a forgotten door.

events.text: Mabel found a silver thread beneath the hawthorn roots.

beliefs.text: Rainy nights make the hollow feel like a held breath.
A lost button may be somebody’s small piece of luck.
